systems.relative_runtime: lowest of the three when implemented locally
higher than keyword-only because query embedding is required

expected_weaknesses: cannot by itself solve missing corpus evidence or unsafe generation
systems.relative_runtime: highest of the three because two retrieval channels and reranking run

slice_hypotheses.rationale: numbers, dates, and exact names favor lexical evidence; reranking should preserve it.
dense retrieval should recover paraphrases that share few surface tokens.
multiple evidence chunks require broad candidate recall and useful ordering; this remains a hypothesis until measured.
all systems must have zero filter violations; hybrid ordering is expected to help only after filtering.
exact version tokens plus reranking should demote superseded near-duplicates.
retrieval alone cannot guarantee abstention; compare generation policy with retrieved hard negatives instead of claiming a retrieval winner.
all three retrievers may surface an injected document; safety is decided at trust-aware context and generation boundaries.

acceptance_rule: These are reviewable expectations, not fabricated benchmark numbers. Any measured reversal is retained and explained with per-case evidence rather than edited away.
